# ARIA ownership atlas

One row per concept family (PLAN-v2 Faz 0.9, F0.9b). The owner, the plan package and the finding are
declared in `ownership_atlas.FAMILIES`; writers (ledger writes and computer definitions), ledgers, callers
and liveness (reached from a cycle phase, a workflow-run script or the kernel CLI) are computed from code;
ledgers read are the declared surfaces the owner's module reads.
A family with no finding has one owner today and `tests/invariants/test_atlas_one_owner.py` keeps it so.

## Provenance

Which ledgers' rows cite which, read from the code that builds each row (`ownership_atlas.ROW_SCOPES`). The
citation vocabulary and the learned memory kinds are declared once in `row_provenance`; a ledger's own id
field is not a citation. Keys are read at scope granularity: a scope that writes two ledgers (as
`emit_change_planned` also writes a governance row) attributes its keys to both.

| Ledger | Row built at | Cites | Learned kind (source fields) |
|---|---|---|---|
| change_committed | `aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_ledger.py:emit_change_committed` | `change_id` → `change_planned`<br>`finding_id` → `repo_finding_events`<br>`plan_id` → `plan_convergence_events` | — |
| change_outcome | `aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_outcome.py:emit_change_outcome` | `change_id` → `change_planned`<br>`commit_sha` → `change_committed`<br>`finding_id` → `repo_finding_events`<br>`plan_id` → `plan_convergence_events` | — |
| change_planned | `aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_ledger.py:emit_change_planned` | `finding_id` → `repo_finding_events`<br>`plan_id` → `plan_convergence_events` | — |
| change_validated | `aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_ledger.py:emit_change_validated` | `change_id` → `change_planned`<br>`commit_sha` → `change_committed`<br>`finding_id` → `repo_finding_events`<br>`plan_id` → `plan_convergence_events` | — |
| kg_conventions | `aria-kernel/aria_kernel/knowledge_graph.py:Pattern`<br>`aria-kernel/aria_kernel/knowledge_graph.py:reconcile_convention_promotion` | `plan_id` → `plan_convergence_events`<br>`supersedes_pattern_id` → `kg_conventions` | `convention` (`plan_id`) |
| memory_beliefs | `aria-kernel/aria_kernel/memory.py:_record_belief` | — | `belief` (`evidence_refs`) |
| memory_procedural | `aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_eval.py:_episode` | `plan_id` → `plan_convergence_events`<br>`supersedes` → `memory_procedural` | `episode` (`plan_id`, `evidence`) |
| plan_convergence_events | `aria-kernel/aria_kernel/plan_convergence.py:_append_event` | — | — |
